explication: This is a Go library for arbitrary-precision fixed-point decimals. A caller constructs or parses Decimal values, performs exact basic arithmetic or precision-controlled division (and optional advanced math), then formats or serializes the result. The implementation is a compact package rather than a service: its main layers are the Decimal API, mathematical operations, and encoding support. The README documents the workflow and serialization capabilities; some internal implementation relationships are omitted because the excerpts do not show their call sites.
